name: How long does it take to install custom window trim on an average home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install custom window trim on an average home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for installing custom window trim depends on the number of windows, the complexity of the trim design, and whether the trim needs to be custom-milled. For a typical home with a moderate number of windows and a standard design, installation might take anywhere from a few days to a week. If specialized materials need to be ordered or custom profiles need to be created, this can add to the lead time. During the initial consultation, our team can provide a more accurate estimate of the project duration based on your specific home and chosen trim style.
